## Direct Kit Support for Antigravity Desktop App on Local Computer (macOS / Linux, NOT Web) — Review Ready

> **Scope note:** This patch is for the **Antigravity desktop app running locally on a computer (macOS / Linux)** — **not** Antigravity on the web (and **not** remote cloud devbox mode).

### Attached Files in Parent Card Drop Box (`r1-antigravity-on-the-web-how-far-it-runs-t`)
- **`antigravity-app-local-kit-support.patch`** (`art-808dddeb811c`, `61,746` bytes) — full unified patch (`28 files changed, 592 insertions(+), 111 deletions(-)`, verified `git apply --check` exit `0` against `anlonlt/board` `feat/streamline-doctor-memory` @ `ffac7df`).
- **`test_antigravity_app_local.py`** (`art-a31a918e8425`, `11,269` bytes) — standalone copy of the 11-test unit suite.
- **`r1-antigravity-app-local-review-guide.md`** (`art-7e22fe907fbc`, `3,766` bytes) — complete review guide, verification outputs, and apply/test commands.

2. **macOS hook timeout crash (`kit/hook.py`):** Added an `os.waitpid(self.pid, os.WNOHANG)` fallback in `_Hook._kill()` when Linux-only `os.waitid()` is absent on macOS.
3. **Unified Antigravity transcript discovery (`kit/hooks/kit_config.py`, `kit_task_train.py`, `kit_pre_compact.py`, `scripts/usage.py`, `scripts/kit.py`, `scripts/step0_scan.py`):** Searches `$ANTIGRAVITY_APP_DATA_DIR`, `~/.gemini/antigravity` (desktop app), `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli`, and `~/.gemini/antigravity-ide` for `brain/<sid>/.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl`.
4. **Native Antigravity desktop session & runtime detection (`scripts/kit.py`, `scripts/usage.py`, `kit/handover.py`, `kit/board/board_cli.py`, `kit/landing.py`, `kit/hooks/kit_memory_jit.py`, `scripts/step0_scan.py`, `scripts/run_all_tests.py`):** Recognizes `ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID`, `ANTIGRAVITY_AGENT`, `ANTIGRAVITY_APP_DATA_DIR`, `AGY_CONVERSATION_ID`, and `__CFBundleIdentifier=com.google.antigravity`, wires `kit.py` `whoami` / `_usage_self()`, and strips `ANTIGRAVITY_*` / `AGY_*` in `run_all_tests.py` `SESSION_VARS`.
5. **OS sandbox resilience (`scripts/device.py`):** Falls back to `<tempdir>/board-kit-<uid>` when `~/.config/board-kit` raises `PermissionError` inside Antigravity's sandbox (preserving explicit `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` / `KIT_JOBS_DIR`).

## Verification Results (macOS 26.6.2 arm64, stock Python 3.9.6)
- Live `python3 -I .kit/usage.py --root . self --no-push` -> `2026-11-26T23:26 part R1 transcript 35b7c7c5-b7a out=67887 cread=7179245 calls=52 tools=164 turns=2 $3.27`
- Live `python3 -I .kit/kit.py whoami` -> `35b7c7c5-b7a5-4ba7-a584-ad6ed7599e9e`
- `python3 scripts/run_all_tests.py -j 1 antigravity_app_local kit_copies_current cl44_agy_runtime cl37_usage device_and_takeover unified_hooks landing handoff launch_runtime` -> **9 suites passed, 159 tests passed, 0 failed** (`test_antigravity_app_local` 11/11, `test_cl44_agy_runtime` 20/20, `test_cl37_usage` 32/32, `test_device_and_takeover` 24/24, `test_handoff` 7/7, `test_landing` 35/35, `test_launch_runtime` 9/9, `test_unified_hooks` 19/19, `test_kit_copies_current` 2/2).
- `git apply --check antigravity-app-local-kit-support.patch` -> exit `0` against `feat/streamline-doctor-memory` @ `ffac7df`.

## Apply & Test Commands
```sh
git apply --check antigravity-app-local-kit-support.patch
git apply antigravity-app-local-kit-support.patch
python3 -m unittest tests.test_antigravity_app_local tests.test_kit_copies_current tests.test_unified_hooks tests.test_cl44_agy_runtime tests.test_cl37_usage tests.test_device_and_takeover -v
```
